instruction: Look at freecad_task-4_input.step in FreeCAD. Before starting the work, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-4_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Preserve the circular flange outside diameter, thickness, and existing center bore. On a bolt circle of radius 38 mm around the flange center, create six equally spaced vertical through holes of diameter 8 mm, with the first hole on the global +X direction and the others every 60 degrees. Export the resulting flange as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-4_output.step.
